historical_source_deliveries.note: Initial source delivery preserved as historical source evidence only.

functional.scope: Corrective source implementation resolving all 7 source defects: (1) IAP-only SSH/SCP (--tunnel-through-iap) with safe pre-SCP remote directory creation over IAP SSH; (2) bare-Debian bootstrap (deploy/staging/bootstrap.sh) for debian-12-bookworm-v20261023 (application_installed=false), digest-pinned @sha256:... image pre-acquisition via docker pull before compose --no-build (pull_policy: never), and external /runtime-config.js rendered outside the sealed FE release directory served no-store; (3) real on-host deploy identity readback queries (docker inspect, curl /bff/readyz, curl /bff/version, deployment.json, .artifact_sha256, mountpoint) emitted after ordinary docker compose stdout; (4) real shipped on-VM gate collector (deploy/staging/pantheon-staging-collect-gates) executing live psql, pg_dump, pg_restore, docker, curl, and mountpoint checks without prebuilt/manufactured booleans; (5) separation of WIF deploy SA (pantheon-stg-github-deploy@...) from VM runtime SA (pantheon-stg-runtime@...), DEPLOYER_SA_FORBIDDEN_ON_VM enforcement, and removal of project-IAM mutations from staging_provision.sh; (6) isolated Postgres password-file secrets (0400/0600 STAGING_POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE + STAGING_SECRETS_ENV_FILE) and full /bff/readyz owner closure (runtime-manager, governance, deployment, lifecycle-projector, operator-bff, postgres, nats); (7) local regressions executing real bootstrap.sh and pantheon-staging-collect-gates under constrained host binaries.
